sources.title: ATX-Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-IQ4_XS-M-GGUF
sources.snippet: The ATX-IQ4_XS-M recipe applied to d0xin/Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-BF16. That model is an uncensored (abliterated) derivative of UkisAI's Swift-Qwen3.8-27B, made by rank-1 directional residual-stream ablation.

sources.title: jakeatx/ATX-Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-IQ4_XS-M-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B | UkisAI
sources.snippet: The results below compare Qwen3.8-27B, the foundation base model, Swift 1.0, the first UkisAI adaptation, and Swift 1.5. All three use the same saved evaluation protocols, and every score is a final five-repeat aggregate.

sources.title: ATX-Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-IQ4_XS-M-GGUF by jakeatx
sources.snippet: ATX-Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-IQ4_XS-M-GGUF is a open-weight jakeatx llm model with a 262,144 token context window. Running this yourself: likely needs a rented cloud gpu.

sources.title: swift-1.5-qwen3.8-27b-uncensored local LLM benchmarks
sources.snippet: Local LLM benchmarks for swift-1.5-qwen3.8-27b-uncensored: 285 tok/s peak across 10 community runs on 1 GPU, with VRAM, context, and quality data by hardware and tool.
